'''Firrerean silk''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Silk/Legends|silk]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate lord]] [[Tantos]] possessed a long Firrerean silk tunic that was tied with a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="Ghostling" /> The silk shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Firrerre/Legends|Firrerre]].<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
